title: BananiPack
description: A ResourcePack themed around the one and only Banana in our Server Team
body:
🍌 RealBananiPack – The Ultimate Banana HUD
Welcome to the RealBananiPack! Developed by the FloloreanerServer Team, this custom resource pack is completely dedicated to the one and only Banani_real. It turns your boring Minecraft interface into a fresh, vibrant, and fully banana-themed HUD!

If you love clean designs and want to rock the ultimate yellow look in your game, this pack is made for you.

✨ Features at a Glance
💛 Golden Health Bar (Hearts): The classic red hearts are gone! They have been completely recolored into bright, juicy yellow hearts, giving you that pure banana energy while surviving.

🍗 Banana Hunger Bar: To match the theme, the hunger icons have been fully redesigned into sleek, bright yellow drumsticks. It’s never been more stylish to keep your hunger bar full!

🎯 Banana Crosshair: A precise and clean custom crosshair. It features a sharp yellow cross with a hollow center, ensuring perfect accuracy for both building and intense PvP combat.

⚡ Custom XP Bar: The experience bar has been overhauled with a smooth, banana-yellow gradient that lights up as you collect levels. The level counter sits perfectly on top in a clean white-grey font.

🧥 Inspired by Banani_real
Every single texture in this HUD has been carefully styled around the personality and skin of Banani_real. It brings a bright, happy, and unique yellow aesthetic directly into your Minecraft world.

👥 Credits
Developer: Created and published by the FloloreanerServer Team.

What are you waiting for? Grab your yellow boots and bring the Banani look straight to your screen!
